clips.title: The story
paras: Barnil Stonepot is trying to restore the opening portion of Hemet Nesingwary's scattered hunting manuscript, The Green Hills of Stranglethorn. He needs four missing leaves gathered from across the jungle to bind the introductory section back together.

Following your talk regarding The Green Hills of Stranglethorn, Barnil Stonepot sets his sights on restoring the book's opening passage. According to the dwarf, this first part sets the stage for the wider story and describes Nesingwary's hunting party, counting Barnil himself among the companions. Unfortunately, the manuscript's leaves remain lost in the wild, leaving pages one, four, six, and eight absent from the collection.
Once you bring back the four missing sheets, Barnil is able to piece the first segment of the master huntsman's text back into a single, cohesive part of the book.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Chapter I was quite riveting! Master Nesingwary sets the backdrop for the story and makes mention of his hunting companions, including me!
But that's besides the point. Let me see which pages are still missing. It seems pages 1, 4, 6 and 8 are still out there somewhere in the jungle!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I don't suppose you were able to track down pages 1, 4, 6 and 8? Those four are all we need to piece Chapter I back together.

clips.title: Completion
paras: At last! Chapter I is complete!
